label: 🔗 Tamper-evident log entry
description: Append a signed-chain log entry capturing this run's hash + the previous entry's hash (Merkle-style chaining). The log file lives at the configured path; tampering with any past entry invalidates every subsequent hash. Use to build an auditable history of pipeline runs.

logPath.label: Log file path
logPath.help: Relative paths resolve under data/outputs/<run>/. Each line is one chained entry.

annotation.label: Annotation
annotation.help: Free-form note appended to this entry (e.g. 'monthly close'). Goes into the chain.
